verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a public API for driving Ente Auth, and every OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404. What exists is adjacent: an export-only CLI, a documented encrypted-export JSON format, and a single search deep link (enteauth://search). None of these is a documented public API for programmatic control of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
